summary: Protect the Kingdom with your Strategy in this Epic Tower Defense Adventure
description: The epic tower defense battles you love are back: welcome to Kingdom Rush 5: Alliance! As a formidable evil emerges over the kingdom, an unexpected alliance is formed: unleash the ultimate tower defense battle to defend the kingdom and the whole realm with the best of both armies! Though they may journey side by side, the typical brawls of an improvised alliance could swiftly alter the tides of the adventure. Prepare to harness the formidable might of dual heroes on td battles! Now, get to handle TWO HEROES at the same time! Clash with dreadful enemies while leading double the action! Of course, your beloved Kingdom Rush signature epic towers couldn’t be left out of the Alliance: recruit Paladins, Archers, Mages, Necromancers, and even more! Kingdom Rush 5: Alliance offers greater action, strategy games, tower defense battles, mighty heroes, and powerful towers than ever before! And of course, the usual wacky humor our tower defense games are known for. Because what’s an epic clash without a few jokes? It’s time to defend the kingdom once again! Get to clash in an epic adventure across incredible terrains, wild td battles, unpredictable challenges, and unexpected threats! GAME FEATURES: Recruit 34 unique heroes and towers! - 18 ELITE TOWERS to build and upgrade What’s a strategy game without mighty defense towers? Seize them to clash against any enemy! Pick between accurate Archers, lethal Paladins, and even trickful Demon Pits. - 16 EPIC HEROES - take tower defense battles to the next level PLAY WITH 2 HEROES SIMULTANEOUSLY! Get ready to witness the formidable might of the most unlikely dual-heroes combinations. A forest guardian spirit and a powerful battle automaton or perhaps a space-bending mage and your average Joe. - 6 TERRAINS with fascinating battlefields to conquer Defend Kingdom Rush’s colorful landscapes. Clash across the realm’s deep forest, or even its dangerous caverns. - 25 CAMPAIGN STAGES full of fast-paced td battles Set your strategy in exotic terrains full of surprising challenges and details. Clash against hordes of unpredictable enemies and epic boss fights to take your defense strategy to the limit! - 3 DIFFERENT GAME MODES to test your might Try different and more challenging ways of playing each stage after you emerge victorious. Who doesn't love a good challenge? - 58+ GAME ACHIEVEMENTS to conquer in battle What’s an epic strategy game without tasty rewards? Show off your skills and unlock prizes! - 45+ DIFFERENT ENEMIES to test your tower defense wits Show the alliance’s td battle skills with 4 different enemy clans. Beat each of them with a unique defense strategy! - And, of course… There are lots of easter eggs and the usual Ironhide Game Studio lighthearted humor.
